This template is to be used for citing individual pages on ''[[Club Penguin]]''{{'}}s [https://www.clubpenguin.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{ClubPenguin|subdomain=|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.clubpenguin.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{ClubPenguin|url=blog/2013/07/club-penguin-star-wars-celebration-europe-2013-0|text=Club Penguin at Star Wars Celebration Europe 2013!|archivedate=20130722005258|nolive=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{ClubPenguin|url=blog/2013/07/club-penguin-star-wars-celebration-europe-2013-0|text=Club Penguin at Star Wars Celebration Europe 2013!|archivedate=20130722005258|nolive=1}}
